name: cavemio-plan
title: Plan
description: An agent’s checklist that ticks itself off: pending, in progress, done, skipped or failed.

cavemio.accessibility:
- It’s an ordered list; each task carries its status as text for screen readers, and the progress count is announced politely.
- The plan never folds itself away after the user has opened or closed it.
- Installs Number roll. With reduced motion the spinner, rolls, strikes and folds stop; states still read clearly.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: collapseWhenDone
props.description: true · Fold into the summary once every task is settled.

props.name: open / defaultOpen / onOpenChange
props.description: true · Control it yourself; any click also stops the automatic folding.

features.title: Five statuses
features.description: Pending, running, done, skipped and failed, each with its own mark.

features.title: Marks that change in place
features.description: The ring becomes a spinner, the spinner blurs into a drawn check, and a strike draws across the label.

features.title: A progress line
features.description: A thin line under the header fills as work completes, and the count (“3 of 5”) rolls.

features.title: Failures stay open
features.description: A failed task shows its reason and keeps the plan open.

features.title: It folds when settled
features.description: When every task is settled, “done” slides in and the plan folds into one line. It never folds after the user opened or closed it.

features.title: Readable by screen readers
features.description: It is an ordered list, each task carries its status as text, and progress is announced politely.

states.title: running
states.description: The ring blurs into a spinner and the label brightens; the task being worked on.

states.title: done
states.description: The spinner blurs out as a filled check draws itself (420ms); a strike-through draws across the label left to right (520ms) as it fades back. The count rolls.

states.title: failed
states.description: A red mark swaps in and the reason folds open underneath; the plan stays open.

states.title: settled
states.description: Every task finished: "done" slides in after "5 of 5" and the list folds away 1.2s later.
